customer_updates.name: SANKET BHATKAR
customer_updates.text: Came to deposit cash for sukanya account, but wasn't aware of timings on Saturday(working till 1pm only. Staff was helpful and understood my situation. Mr. Mande went out of the way and was sitting beyond his lunch time and accepted my deposit and saved me another days time and efforts of coming again on Monday. Special thanks to the wonderful and efficient team at Mahim post office.

featured_reviews.name: DNYANRAJ PATKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited the Post Office with around 25 kids from Dadar Sanskar Warg as study tour. We found the staff very cooperative. They showed the kids, complete post office, various sections explaining the functions of each. They gave maximum information about various types of services offered by Post.The kids even wrote letters to their parents and posted. The post office has huge place.

featured_reviews.name: Trafalgar's Law
featured_reviews.review_text: Opens at 10am. For offline aadhar updation they only take 20 people per day so there is always a huge line. Parking space is available and the staff is extremely helpful while answering questions. The office is located at the corner of a street and hence is easily visible from the road

featured_reviews.name: Yash Churi
featured_reviews.review_text: Unfortunately Need to Give this one star. Worst service. Bill payment and parcel dispatch window is only one so there is alot of line and people waiting in queue. People working and their working accuracy is very much slow taking own time the recruitment should be done better and taken proper measures. The IT team needs to be everytime around the counters because the servers, The Computers crash or don’t respond anytime and makes the situation worst!. Overall Worst !!

featured_reviews.name: Cheryl Mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text: I am happy that the staff of Mahim head post office did my work even after the working hours for the public. Just one thing, kindly keep a dustbin in the post office. It does not cost much. Instead of people throwing waste on the floor.
